label: a14_propositional_join
hypothesis: Replace list transport lemma by a pure propositional Or-elimination combinator

label: a15_exclude_replacement
hypothesis: Separate the replacement identifier before induction to reduce disjunction alternatives

label: a16_unfold_class_once
hypothesis: Unfold the variable projection once before induction rather than in every branch

label: a17_obvious_branches
hypothesis: Discharge reflexive and left-injection branches before invoking grind

label: a18_no_nil_reductions
hypothesis: Trade fewer simp lemmas against grind handling nil and propositional reduction

label: a19_exclude_scoped
hypothesis: Repair by_cases scope while retaining the excluded-new-variable induction

label: a20_direct_special
hypothesis: Use definitional projection reduction and direct Or injections for replacement cases

label: a21_uniform_splits
hypothesis: Defer membership simplification until after uniform match and if splitting

label: a22_uniform_repeat
hypothesis: Replace explicit application case with repeated structural split and shared final closure

label: a23_exclude_uniform
hypothesis: Avoid branch-tag dependence after by_cases by splitting matches uniformly

label: a24_exclude_tag
hypothesis: Use the actual neg.app constructor tag exposed by Lean diagnostics

label: a25_defeq_uniform
hypothesis: Combine repeated splitting with a single initial definitional projection reduction

label: a26_reduced_membership
hypothesis: Let grind preprocess singleton membership while simplifying only list appends

label: a27_unfold_then_grind
hypothesis: Pre-reduce the typeclass projection so grind definitions can match induction hypotheses
